description: Land Title Settlement Department - Dehipagoda, Udunuwara D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320241 and others
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains multiple declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed property descriptions, ownership details, extents, encumbrances, and cadastral information. The content falls squarely within the definition of Land Gazettes as it concerns land registrations, property ownership determinations, and title settlements for specific parcels of land.
